points.description: States "Windrow" (windrow composting) as one of the three systems.
States "Static-aerated piles" (aerated static pile composting) as one of the three systems.
States "In-vessel composting" (enclosed/in-vessel system) as one of the three systems, and gives no wrong extra system (e.g. vermicomposting, which the question excludes).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) only if all three systems are named with the correct technical terms: windrow, static-aerated piles, in-vessel. Each correct item earns its share; vague descriptions such as "pile" or "open heap" without the term earn nothing for that item. A wrong extra item (including vermicomposting) means P3 earns nothing.
